caption:
“Studied” can mean three people and no control group 🔬 The ladder goes: cells, then animals, then a handful of people, then real trials. Some of the most talked-about compounds never passed that third rung — and without a control group you cannot tell the treatment from time simply passing.

Every entry at pepsafe.info grades the evidence, not the hype.
